# Cancellation of all ultraviolet divergences of quantum gravity: the second manuscript in its submitted form (v3.2.0)

This release carries the second manuscript, "Cancellation of all ultraviolet divergences of quantum gravity by a scale-invariant gas of branes" by Deep Bhattacharjee and Ushashi Bhattacharya (`uv-finite/`), in the form submitted to the Journal of High Energy Physics and to Hexagon. The theorem is unchanged: for n ≥ 4, almost every frozen realization of a scale-invariant Poisson gas of branes gives a graviton theory with no ultraviolet divergence at any order of perturbation theory, no running of Newton's constant or the cosmological constant, three finite one-loop tunings, a finite regulator-independent zero-point energy, and a unitary S matrix at every loop order.

- Every one of the 88 registered references was checked against its Crossref or Zenodo record (title, authors, journal, volume, pages, year); all fifteen plotted figures, the TikZ diagrams, the fifty-one footnotes and the eleven tables are in place.
- `paper/paper1/` holds the compiled manuscript (`uv-finite-brane-gas.pdf`) and `paper/paper2/` its source with the figures (`uv-finite-brane-gas-tex.zip`), the two files of the submission.
- The manuscript names this release, 3.2.0, as the archive of its code, figures and audit, through the concept DOI; the version DOI is recorded once Zenodo mints it.

The first and third manuscripts are unchanged from 3.0.0.

Assets: for each manuscript the PDF, the LaTeX source (tex.zip) and the arXiv package (tar.gz) with its code in `anc/`, and the figures of the second manuscript (figures.zip).
